highlights: Recive 4 mpd on 2 selected categories out of 7 (petrol, transport, flight bookings, hotel bookings, department stores, supermarkets, dining, retail, local purchases, and foreign currency spending). Plus, enjoy unlimited 0.4 mpd on all other spend outside enrolled rewards category. Bonus UNI$ is capped at 5,600 UNI$ / 8,000 miles (equivalent to S$2,000 in spend) per month.
pros: Pick from 7 rewards categories to earn up to 25X UNI$ for every S$5 spend (10 miles per S$1)
pros: 10X UNI$ for every S$5 spent (equivalent to 4 miles per S$1) on 2 of your preferred rewards categories..
pros: Up to additional 15X UNI$ per S$5 spent (6 miles per S$1) when you save with UOB Lady's Savings Account
pros: UNI$1 per S$5 spent (equivalent to 0.4 miles per S$1) on other purchases.
pros: Complimentary travel insurance coverage of up to US$100,000.
cons: S$5 earning blocks for miles.

extra.description: The UOB Lady's Solitaire Card is a tier above the UOB Lady's Card, with a higher income requirement. However, it comes with a S$1,500 monthly bonus cap instead. Plus, you'll be able to select two of seven preferred categories, instead of one (Fashion, Dining, Travel, Beauty and Wellness, Family, Transport or Entertainment).
